messages.subject: creating boundry for spatial points
parts:
Dear INLA group,

I need to create a mesh for real data. In the first step, when I'm trying to have a grid with
gridded(data)<- TRUE, I got an error as follows:

suggested tolerance minimum: 0.999973
Error in points2grid(points, tolerance, round) :
  dimension 1 : coordinate intervals are not constant

I've tried to fix this with sp::SpatialPixelsDataFrame and  sp::spTransform() but It doesn't work again. What can I do?

Thanks in advance for your help and time.

Leila

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] creating boundry for spatial points
parts:
Hi,
You don't have to do it in this way. You can use the actual coordinates in the inla.mesh.2d() function.
Elias
